messages:
natalie: quick follow-up to today's all-hands Q&A: leadership asked for a concise capture of why we win/lose and the top customer asks. dropping notes and owners here.

sam: TL;DR from leadership: wins = predictable perf + fast pilots + clear security docs. losses = procurement friction (price + transparency), missing private/VPC options, and hallucination concerns on critical content.

mira: field notes: midmarket often pauses on pricing visibility (per-route caps requested). enterprise deals stall on legal/KYC timelines and private deployment guarantees.

alex: CS adds: top asks = 1) VPC/on-prem timeline 2) token-level billing exports 3) formal SLO packages + longer metrics retention. Also request simple fallback policy docs for latency spikes.

devin: Eng update: runtime KV cache + adaptive batching landing next release -> expected ~15-25% p95 improvement for long chats. PR: `runtime/kv-cache` (link to be posted). Also prototype `telemetry.token_breakdown` flag for Console.

tara: Product: proposing 3 SLO tiers (bronze/silver/gold) and a midmarket pricing playbook. will draft and share by next Wed.

ci-bot: action created: TICKET-4999 "All-hands: wins/losses & customer asks" assigned to natalie, mira, devin.

mira: I'll own pricing playbook + midmarket table. will sync w/ finance and SE. ETA: draft by Mon.

devin: I'll own perf SLO proposal + telemetry prototype. ETA: bench results + draft SLOs by Wed.

alex: CS will publish top 10 asks + sanitized loss examples and sample prompts by EOW.

natalie: small ask: owners add a 1-line customer-facing message for partners and an ETA to TICKET-4999 by EOD Monday. we'll review at leadership sync Thursday.

sam: optional: collect 2 clear win case studies where caching/ops runbook sealed the deal. marketing can turn them into short win notes.

tara: noted. also tracking request for 1y metrics retention feasibility. will add infra cost estimate to the brief.

devin: will include retention cost note.

natalie: thanks everyone  concise and actionable. tagging next steps in the ticket; I'll circulate a 1-paragraph summary once tickets are updated. :thumbsup:
